Frequently asked questions

Is Cologny safe?

Wandroz rates Cologny in Geneva as an area where the review found nothing traveller-relevant to report. That rating rests on an area-level review that reached no traveller-relevant reporting specific to Cologny — no incidents, no recurring problems, nothing documented either way — read together with the character of the area. It is not a positive finding of safety: an absence of reporting is weaker evidence than the sourced ratings elsewhere on this map, and it is marked as such wherever it appears.

What was checked for Cologny?

The same area-level review every other neighbourhood on the Geneva map gets: local and national news, municipal and police-published material, and official surveys where they exist, searched for this specific area. Cologny returned nothing traveller-relevant, which is common for smaller administrative areas without a press profile of their own. Where a review does return something, the sources are named on the area's page.

Is Cologny a good area to stay in as a tourist?

Nothing documented argues against it. For a stay, weigh that against the areas on the Geneva map whose ratings are backed by named sources, and check recent reviews for the specific street. You can search accommodation already scoped to this area using the Booking.com link on this page.
